items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Miles was someplace and we were together and he told me that he was glad that I joined John’s band because he said that he knew that John was headed in another direction musically with cycles and all the things John was doing and he encouraged me.

ctx.x: So you met in a social situation, you met on the bandstand, you met in a club?
I met him through . . . well actually he was with Miles, but I think I met him after when he left Miles.
When he was with the Jazztet.
